selection.selection_basis: Small non-security regression set spanning runnable references, deterministic regeneration, planted solved outputs, and observed reward for an empty submission.

artifact_policy.v7_to_v8_rule: A V7 tier of REPAIR records that a bounded repair may exist. Under V8 operational eligibility, the exact original artifact remains REJECT.
artifact_policy.repaired_derivative_rule: A repaired derivative needs a distinct artifact identity and a fresh V8 review. It must not silently replace the original artifact in this guard set.
artifact_policy.runtime_evidence_rule: Only archived receipts with an observed reward field are called runtime evidence. Static traces are labeled static and are never promoted to observed reward claims.

guards.title: Runnable numeric oracle can replace the requested Rust implementation

static_evidence.claim: The requested core is extracting the constants, implementing calculate_sequence in the Rust codebase, and writing a real regression test.
The image retains /app/legacy_calc, an executable that computes the exact sequence for arbitrary n.
The regression test is checked only for file and executable mode; it is never run.
The grader queries any service on port 8080 and does not bind responses to the Rust crate, allowing a proxy to the runnable oracle.

guards.runtime_evidence_status: No reward-1 receipt is asserted for this guard; rejection rests on the complete static trace.
guards.reject_invariant: The original artifact is operationally ineligible while the rollout-visible oracle can supply every graded numeric answer and the grader does not execute the requested implementation.
guards.repair_boundary: A verifier that builds and launches the submitted Rust service and removes or isolates the oracle would be a different artifact requiring fresh review.

guards.title: Readable deterministic generator bypasses deleted-file recovery

static_evidence.claim: The core requires recovering a still-open deleted log, fixing malformed-line handling, and using exact arithmetic.
The readable deterministic generator contains every input record and can recreate the supposedly deleted log.
The original grader checks only a 10001-line count and a fixed sum string; it never checks recovery provenance or runs aggregator.py.

guards.runtime_evidence_status: No reward-1 receipt on the exact original verifier is used here; later repaired-verifier failures are not evidence about original-artifact eligibility.
guards.reject_invariant: The original artifact is ineligible because deterministic regeneration plus directly authored deliverables can satisfy the grade without deleted-file recovery or the requested aggregator repair.
guards.repair_boundary: Fresh grade-time inputs and execution of the submitted aggregator can define a repaired derivative, but cannot change the original guard decision.

guards.title: Build script plants both exact graded outputs

static_evidence.claim: The requested core spans dump diagnosis, cleaning the asset, fixing threshold arithmetic, and executing the build.
The rollout-visible build.sh contains both exact values later asserted by the grader: VALID_ASSET_123 and BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
The grader reads only the two directly writable artifacts and never runs calculate_threshold.sh or build.sh.

runtime_evidence.claim: The empty control failed as expected.
Two direct writes of the planted literals produced reward 1; pytest reported two passed tests.

guards.runtime_evidence_status: Observed discriminating pair: empty 0, planted-output reproduction 1.
guards.reject_invariant: The original artifact must remain REJECT because the planted exact outputs have an archived reward-1 counterexample requiring no dump analysis, arithmetic repair, or build execution.
guards.repair_boundary: Removing planted answers and executing the build at grade time creates a repaired derivative; V7's REPAIR tier does not make this original artifact eligible.

guards.title: Differential grader exposes the executable reference to the submission

static_evidence.claim: The required behavior is an independent pure-Python implementation matching the legacy decoder.
The reference remains executable at /app/backup_decoder after only its C source is deleted.
The grader runs the submitted script beside the same reachable oracle on every fuzz input and compares return code, stdout, and stderr without isolating the oracle.

runtime_evidence.claim: The empty control failed because decoder.py was absent.
A subprocess wrapper around /app/backup_decoder produced reward 1 over the full fuzz comparison.

guards.runtime_evidence_status: Observed discriminating pair: empty 0, runnable-reference wrapper 1.
guards.reject_invariant: The original artifact must remain REJECT while a wrapper can execute the grader's own oracle and an archived receipt shows reward 1.
guards.repair_boundary: A grade-time-only oracle isolated from the submission can form a repaired derivative; the original executable-reference artifact remains guarded.

guards.title: Untouched original image receives reward 1
guards.security_selection: The instruction is a database performance and correctness task; no security behavior or exploit construction is involved.

static_evidence.claim: The task requires analyzing the database, optimizing the Rust implementation, compiling it, and meeting a two-second correctness threshold.
Setup creates the complete database and golden output before the rollout.
Setup writes the original Rust program that the task says must be optimized.
Setup pre-builds the original program into the image.
The grader deletes only the output, then runs whatever Rust program is already present and accepts it if it meets the timing and golden-output checks; it does not require a rollout change.

runtime_evidence.claim: The recorded untouched-container gate observed reward 1 with setup skipped.

guards.runtime_evidence_status: Observed reward-for-nothing receipt; this is not a static inference.
guards.reject_invariant: Any exact original artifact that rewards the untouched image is operationally REJECT, regardless of whether its preinstalled implementation happens to satisfy the assertions.
guards.repair_boundary: A derivative must make the untouched state score 0 and bind reward to rollout work; it receives a new artifact identity and review rather than replacing this guard.
